transcript.statement: The library management system must prioritize sustainability through energy efficiency, waste reduction, and carbon footprint awareness. GRN-01 ensures we use energy-efficient infrastructure to minimize energy consumption. GRN-02 provides transparency in energy usage, while GRN-03 promotes digital notifications to cut down on paper waste. GRN-04 encourages awareness of the carbon impact of books. GRN-05 ensures responsible disposal of damaged books. GRN-06 tracks energy savings for accountability, and GRN-07 emphasizes e-book acquisition to reduce physical resource consumption. These requirements collectively enhance the system's sustainability.

transcript.statement: The library management system must prioritize security and privacy to protect member data and ensure auditability. TRU-01 ensures that only authenticated members can borrow or return books, while TRU-02 logs all transactions for accountability. TRU-03 mandates data encryption to safeguard personal information. TRU-04 establishes role-based access control to mitigate unauthorized access. TRU-05 provides a secure reporting mechanism for overdue books, and TRU-06 allows members to update their information securely. Finally, TRU-07 enforces strong password policies to enhance account security. Together, these requirements create a robust security framework.

transcript.statement: The library management system must ensure safety and reliability for all users. SAF-01 limits simultaneous book borrowing to prevent overload on the system, while SAF-02 ensures timely notifications for overdue books, promoting responsibility. SAF-03 prevents double borrowing by maintaining real-time inventory status, enhancing reliability. SAF-04 provides a backup mechanism for data recovery, crucial for fault tolerance. SAF-05 allows librarians to revoke borrowing privileges, ensuring safety for all users. SAF-06 enforces user authentication to protect against unauthorized access, and SAF-07 logs all transactions for accountability. Together, these requirements create a safe and reliable library management system.

requirements.text: The library management system shall enforce a maximum of 5 simultaneous borrow operations to ensure safety, reliability, and equitable access.
The library management system shall automatically track and notify members of overdue books digitally within 24 hours of the due date.
The library management system shall maintain real-time inventory status of all books to prevent double borrowing.
The library management system shall provide a backup mechanism to recover all transaction data in case of a failure.
The library management system shall allow librarians to revoke borrowing privileges for members with outstanding overdue books.
The library management system shall implement a user authentication process to ensure only registered members can access borrowing features.
The library management system shall log all transactions, including borrow and return actions, for audit and accountability purposes.
The library management system shall enable searching for books with a response time of under 2 seconds for 95% of queries.
The library management system shall process book returns within 1 second to maintain high throughput.
The library management system shall maintain an uptime of 99.5% to ensure consistent availability for users.
The library management system shall minimize energy consumption by using energy-efficient servers and infrastructure.
The library management system shall provide an accessible interface for all users to promote fairness and inclusivity.
The library management system shall enforce data encryption for all member personal information stored.
The library management system shall provide a mechanism to report and manage overdue books securely.
The library management system shall allow members to update their personal information securely.
The library management system shall require strong password policies for member accounts.
The library management system shall provide an energy usage report for library operations at least quarterly.
The library management system shall track the total energy savings achieved through digital operations compared to traditional methods.
The library management system shall provide an annual report on usage statistics to ensure transparency in library operations.

conflict_resolutions.rationale: Safety concerns necessitate limiting simultaneous borrow operations to prevent overload.
Digital notifications can enhance accountability while supporting sustainability goals.
User authentication is critical to maintain system security despite potential performance delays.
Data protection compliance requires the implementation of encryption for member data.
The conflict between fast search responses and thorough auditing remains unresolved.
